title: Barak Nixon's New Life
body: Barak Nixon, a Nova survivor, marries Li-Yam in a ceremony surrounded by family and friends, marking the end of a personal journey that began in terror.

title: Toldos Avraham Yitzchak Shabbos
body: Thousands of chassidim gathered in Yerushalayim's Meah Shearim for a historic Shabbos marking 29 years since a momentous day in the life of the Toldos Avraham Yitzchak chassidus.
